verification.notes: Draft, not reviewed by a Federal Ministry of Education, WAEC or NECO officer. No official senior-secondary subject list or syllabus was fetched: the subjects are WASSCE subject names and the 8-to-9 subject count and core areas come from a news report of the Ministry's announcement, so every senior-secondary subject, department and combination rule is unconfirmed. Open items: (1) the A1 to F9 percentage ranges follow spec 03 Appendix G and secondary sources; WAEC awards each subject's grades itself. (2) The four departments (Science, Arts, Commercial, Technical) are from spec 03 Appendix G; the news report names Humanities, Sciences, Business, Trade and Technology areas instead. (3) WASSCE and NECO SSCE subject codes are not modelled. (4) The credit count is a count of A1 to C6 grades; the institution-specific rule 'five credits including English and Mathematics' is not encoded. (5) The CA 40 and exam 60 split is the common school practice of spec 03 Appendix G, overridable. (6) The Hausa labels are a draft translation that no native speaker has reviewed.
